tactics.title: Taktikbriet
tactics.name: Numm vum Plang
tactics.noLevel: Lued ënner Level e Level, fir drop ze plangen; ouni een ass d’Briet eng flaach Fläch.
tactics.hint.select: Click a figure, waypoint, route, area or note to select it; Shift+click adds or removes, Shift+drag draws a box, Ctrl+A takes everything in this step. Delete removes the selection (after asking).
tactics.hint.place: Klickt an de Level, fir déi gewielte Figur do hinzestellen. R dréint se.
tactics.hint.throw: Click the thrower, then where it should land: the ring is how far this throw reaches, a landing past it comes in to its edge, and the arc is the real flight. The chosen utility appears where it lands.
tactics.hint.note: Click where the note goes and type its text; its colour, size and when it shows are set below, and for a selected note in Selected.
tactics.hint.erase: Click a figure, route, area, note or drawing to remove it from this step on.
tactics.hint.moving: Klickt, wou déi gewielte Figur an dësem Schrëtt steet.
tactics.hint.finish: Enter, a double click, a right click or Esc finishes it; Backspace takes the last point back.
tactics.figureScaleHint: 1× ass déi richteg Gréisst; méi grouss liest sech vu wäit uewen besser.
tactics.label: Beschrëftung
tactics.clearConfirm: De ganze Plang eidel maachen? Réckgängeg bréngt en zréck.
tactics.file.bad: That file is not a board this viewer reads: {reason}
tactics.addStep: Schrëtt derbäisetzen; d’Figure fänken en do un, wou hir Weeër opgehalen hunn
tactics.valorant.failed: D’Kaarte konnten net vu valorant-api.com gelueden ginn: {reason}
tactics.gizmo.title: Transforméieren
tactics.gizmo.hint: Zitt e Feil fir laanscht him ze verschieben, e Quadrat a senger Ebene, d'Mëtt iwwer de Level; d'Réng dréinen. Haalt Ctrl fir um Raster oder Wénkelschrëtt unzerasten. Esc brécht d'Zéien of.
tactics.speed.source.official: Geschwindegkeete vun de verëffentlechte Wäerter vum Spill (kuckt Beweegungsgeschwindegkeeten an der Dokumentatioun).
tactics.speed.source.approx: Ongeféier Geschwindegkeeten (gemooss oder typesch; kuckt Beweegungsgeschwindegkeeten an der Dokumentatioun). Setzt Är eegen, wou Dir et besser wësst.
tactics.route.title: Route: {total} s, Ukunft um {at}
tactics.timing.title: Timing
tactics.timing.realTime: Play in real time (a step lasts until its slowest route arrives); either way no figure moves faster than its top speed
tactics.timing.hint: D'Zäite follegen der Uewerfläch an der Neigung vum Level mat der Geschwindegkeet vun all Modus fir d'Figur; CS2-Kaarte sinn a Spilleenheeten (39,37 pro Meter).
tactics.timeline.title: Ukënften
tactics.tele.title: Mat Matchdaten vergläichen
tactics.tele.hint: Lued CS2-Matchtabellen vun dëser Kaart (oder notzt déi geluede Daten), fir ze gesinn, wéi séier d'Spiller wierklech dohinner koumen, wou Ären Plang higeet.
tactics.tele.noRounds: déi gelueden Daten hunn keng Rondenzäiten
tactics.tele.speedsHint: Richteg Geschwindegkeeten a m/s, tëscht Moossunge während der Beweegung.
tactics.tele.noStates: D'Daten hunn keng Kolonne fir de Beweegungszoustand (goen, duckelen).
tactics.tele.compareHint: Wielt eng Figur mat Route oder hir Route, fir hir Zäit mat där vun de Spiller ze vergläichen.
tactics.tele.compare: Am schnellsten observéiert {fastest} s ({who}), p10 {p10} s, Median {median} s iwwer {n} Läf; Ären Plang {plan} s.
tactics.tele.none: Kee Spiller an den Daten ass vun do bis do gaangen.
tactics.hint.waypoints: Click a figure, then each waypoint: it walks them when played. With several figures selected, the route is the group's (each keeps its place in the group). Begun off every figure it is a free arrow.
tactics.hint.measure: Click points to measure the way through them in metres, with the time it takes running.
tactics.draft.finish: {n, plural, one {# waypoint} other {# waypoints}}{group, plural, one {} other { for # figures}} · Enter, double click, right click or Esc to finish
tactics.measure.label: {m} m · {run} s running
tactics.removeConfirm: {n, plural, one {Remove the selected item?} other {Remove the # selected items?}} Undo brings it back.
tactics.layers.title: Layers
tactics.layers.activeHint: New figures, routes, areas, notes and drawings go on this layer.
tactics.layers.renameHint: Click to draw on it, double-click to rename it.
tactics.layers.shown: Shown: what is on it is drawn and played. Hidden: neither.
tactics.layers.locked: Locked: drawn and played, but nothing on it can be picked or changed.
tactics.layers.duplicateHint: A copy of the active layer to work on; the original is hidden, and routes of figures on other layers stay those figures' routes.
tactics.layers.upHint: Move the layer up: its routes play over the ones below
tactics.layers.removeConfirm: Remove the layer {name} and the {n} things on it? Undo brings them back.
tactics.layers.only: Draw only the active layer's routes (the others still play)
tactics.layers.lockedActive: The active layer is locked: nothing new can go on it.
tactics.layers.conflicts: {n, plural, one {# figure has} other {# figures have}} routes in this step on more than one shown layer; the upper layer's route plays.
tactics.layers.hint: Put each squad, plan or alternative on its own layer. Hide a layer to leave it out of the view and of playback; lock it to keep it from being changed.
tactics.author: Your name
tactics.authorPlaceholder: Signed on saved boards and shared edits
tactics.autosave.restored: The board you left was restored from this browser ({at}).
tactics.autosave.full: The board is too large for this browser to keep: save it to a file.
tactics.autosave.none: The board is kept in this browser a moment after each change, where the browser allows it.
tactics.speed.top: Top speed {v} m/s ({kmh} km/h): no route, wanted time or move between steps makes it faster.
tactics.keys.title: Keyframes at {at} ({s} s)
tactics.keys.remove: Remove the key at this moment
tactics.keys.aiming: Click on the level where it should point at this moment; Esc stops.
tactics.keys.hint: Angles from the hull's forward, right and up positive. Pick the moment with the time slider under the view; between keys a value turns the short way, before the first and after the last it holds.
tactics.keys.offBoard: The figure is not on the board at this moment.
tactics.route.wantHint: When to be at this waypoint, seconds from the step's start: the way there is spread to arrive then, never faster than the figure's top speed.
tactics.route.late: Waypoint {point}: wanted at {want} s, but at top speed it gets there at {got} s.
tactics.checks.none: Every figure keeps within its top speed.
tactics.checks.title: Speed limits ({n})
tactics.checks.late: Step {step}: {who} cannot be at waypoint {point} by {given} s; at top speed it is there at {needs} s.
tactics.checks.slide: Step {step}: {who} moves to its next place without a route; at top speed that takes {needs} s, so the step lasts that long instead of {given} s.
tactics.checks.squeezed: Step {step}: {who}'s route takes {needs} s at top speed; the step lasts that long instead of its set {given} s.
tactics.timeHint: Drag to see the plan at any moment and to set keyframes there; ▶ plays from here.
tactics.hint.draw: Drag on the level to draw with the pen or the highlighter; for a circle click the middle, then the edge. The camera does not turn while this tool is in hand: fly with the keys, or turn with the right button.
tactics.note.startNowHint: Start it at the moment shown (the time slider)
tactics.throw.reach: Reaches {m} m on the flat (launched at {speed} m/s, gravity {g} m/s²).
tactics.throw.src.public: Real-world figures; the game may differ.
tactics.mission.replace: Put the mission in place of the board? Undo brings the board back.
tactics.mission.done: Read {units} units in {groups} groups, {airbases} airbases and FARPs, {zones} zones and {markers} markers; each side is on its own layer.
tactics.mission.map: Set on {map}: load that level to plan on its ground.

tactics.dcs.warn.removed: {n, plural, one {# Grupp erausgeholl: Triggeren, déi se nennen, fannen se net méi.} other {# Gruppen erausgeholl: Triggeren, déi se nennen, fannen se net méi.}}

tactics.dcs.warn.air-only: {group}: {what} ass eng Aufgab just fir Loftgefierer.
tactics.dcs.warn.sweep-ground: {group}: DCS huet keng Sweep-Aufgab fir Buedemeenheeten.
tactics.dcs.warn.no-target: {group}: {what} brauch eng aner Grupp um Briet, op déi et wierkt.
tactics.dcs.warn.state: {group}: {what} ass en Zoustand, deen dës Aart Eenheet am Spill net huet.

tactics.dcs.warn.start: Aufgaben, déi méi spéit wéi hire Weepunkt ufänke sollen, fänken an DCS um Weepunkt un.

tactics.dcs.warn.wt-count: {group}: Eng War-Thunder-Eenheet ass ee Fluch oder ee Zuch; {n, plural, one {# Figur um Briet bleift} other {# Figuren um Briet bleiwen}} eng Eenheet.
tactics.dcs.warn.wt-player: Keng blo Eenheet fir de Spiller: wielt eng am Mission Editor.
tactics.mission.openHint: E Missiounsfichier als Briet: DCS World (.miz), War Thunder (.blk), Arma 3 (mission.sqm oder eng Missiouns-.pbo), IL-2 Great Battles (.Mission, .msnbin), Falcon BMS (.ini, .cam, .tac) oder Arma Reforger (.layer). All Säit kënnt op hir eegen Schicht, an de Level vun der Missioun gëtt gelueden, wann de Level-Ordner en huet. „Als Missioun späicheren“ schreift d'Briet erëm dran.
tactics.mission.saveHint: Schreift d'Briet als Missioun fir säi Spill: an d'Missioun, aus där et koum, oder als nei Missioun.
tactics.mission.missing: {name} ass an dëser Sessioun net op: wielt en nach eng Kéier, fir dran ze schreiwen, oder schreift eng nei Missioun.
tactics.mission.levelFound: Hire Level, {name}, gëtt aus dem Level-Ordner gelueden.

tactics.dcs.warn.arma-loose-route: {group}: en eidelt Gefier oder en eenzelen Objet huet an Arma 3 keng Weepunkten; setzt et an Eden an eng Grupp.
tactics.dcs.warn.arma-air: {group}: e neie Fliger start do, wou en um Briet steet; setzt en an Eden an d'Loft oder op eng Pist.
tactics.dcs.warn.arma-new: Eng nei Arma-3-Missioun fir {what}: leet mission.sqm an e Missiounsordner mam Numm <name>.{what} a späichert se eng Kéier an Eden, sou datt se d'Addons opleescht, déi se brauch.
tactics.dcs.warn.arma-text: D'mission.sqm war binariséiert; si gëtt als Text geschriwwen, deen Arma 3 genee esou liest.
tactics.dcs.warn.il2-type: {group}: {what} gouf zu enger anerer Aart; IL-2 behält säin Typ: ännert en am Mission Editor.
tactics.dcs.warn.il2-task: {group}: {what} brauch e Kommando am Mission Editor vun IL-2; et gëtt net geschriwwen.
tactics.dcs.warn.il2-no-entity: {group}: huet keng Entitéit an der Missioun, dofir ginn hir nei Weepunkten net geschriwwen.
tactics.dcs.warn.il2-new: Eng nei IL-2-Missioun: kontrolléiert d'Joreszäit vun der Kaart, d'Wolleken an d'Bewaffnung vun de Fligeren am Mission Editor.
tactics.dcs.warn.il2-binary: Als Text-.Mission vum Editeur gespäichert, net als .msnbin: maach se am Missiounseditor vun IL-2 op, deen d'binär Form späichert.
tactics.dcs.warn.bms-new: Eng nei Kassett enthält nëmmen d'Steierpunkten: kopéier hiren Abschnitt [STPT] an d'<Opruffzeechen>.ini vum Pilot, oder wiel dee Fichier fir dran ze schreiwen.
tactics.dcs.warn.bms-no-route: Kee Fluch mat Route: d'Steierpunkte vun der Kassett bleiwen eidel.
tactics.dcs.warn.bms-stpt-many: {group}: {n} Steierpunkten; d'Kassett hëlt 24, de Rescht gëtt ausgelooss.
tactics.dcs.warn.bms-ppt-many: {n} Bedroungszonen; d'Kassett hëlt 15, de Rescht gëtt ausgelooss.

tactics.dcs.warn.bms-lines: {n} Linnen; d'Kassett hëlt véier Linne mat sechs Punkten, de Rescht gëtt ausgelooss.
